main_text.p: ignorabant ob crefcentem maritimam potentiam fuam invidiâ adverfum fe tumere Lacedæmonios, & caufas bellandi honeftas tantum quærere, fociifque fe munire. Corinthios verò jamdudum fe odiffe: Thebanos vicinos fuos ira quoque in fefe ardere: & ab his omnibus alios quoque intra & extra Peloponnefum in partes trahi. Itaque Corcyræos rebus maritimis ante alios Græcos plurimum valentes malebant fibi devincire, quàm defertos ab fe accrefcere eofdem partibus adverfis. Acceffit Corinthiis & ftimulus alter ex Potidæa colonia fua paulò pòft obfefla & oppugnata ab iifdem Athenienfibus. Dimicatum ad Corcyram quinquennio feré ante initium belli Peloponnenfis, [illegible, ~5 letters]Olympiadis lxxxvi anno primo inituro.

Potidæa obsideri cæpit biennio pòft, & pugna ad eam commiffa inter Athenienfes & Corinthios, cum duraffet obfidio annos duos & menfes aliquot, femeftri ante belli Peloponnenfis principium. Dein quinto belli hujus anno, cum flueret Olympiadis lxxxviii [illegible, ~4 letters]annis[?] primus, atrociffima feditio Corcyræ pene evertit. Nam captivi, [illegible, ~3 letters]de quibus dixi, domum à Corinthiis dimiffi, ut[?] precium redemptionis fuæ, talenta lxxxx[?], pro quibus Corinthii

page.notes: The left margin is largely cut off or covered by the red edge of the book; marginal fragments were not legible enough to transcribe and appear only as placeholders. Doubtful readings are marked [?]: "annis" (possibly "anno"), "ut", and "lxxxx" (the talent figure). The bottom-left fragments ("bro", "pro", "oigpr") are unreadable note remnants. The "[illegible]" placeholders in the margin are approximate. The printed text reads "Olympiadis lxxxvi" with the "O" partly hidden by a margin fragment.
